zh-CN.name: 深维智讯・学习闪卡
zh-CN.description: 学习闪卡是一种 AI 驱动的知识学习工具。将产品资料、课程文档或知识主题快速生成学习闪卡，支持选择题、问答题、朗读背诵等练习方式，帮助你快速掌握和巩固重点知识。支持 AI 出题、改题和调整题目数量。
examples: 基于我上传的产品资料出一套 8 道单选题的闪卡课
把这套闪卡改成 12 道题
给我这套闪卡的学习链接，我要在手机上练习
看看刚建的闪卡课程里都有哪些题目

en.name: Megaview Flashcard Coach
en.description: Flashcard Coach is an AI-powered knowledge learning tool. Generate study flashcards from product materials, course documents, or any knowledge topic, with multiple-choice, Q&A, and read-and-recite practice modes to help you master and reinforce key knowledge fast. AI writes and edits questions and adjusts question counts.
examples: Create a flashcard course with 8 single-choice questions from my uploaded document
Change this flashcard set to 12 questions
Give me the learn URL so I can practice on my phone
Show me the questions in the flashcard course I just created
